White narrow paper margin around a fully colored square scene. Scene: a chubby MARIGOLD-GOLD squirrel standing slightly right of center leans forward hugging ONE oversized acorn in left foreground. Acorn is a simple pale-warm-yellow rounded egg with a broad chocolate-brown cap on top and short stem, no crosshatching. steps_prompt:
Create ONE tall portrait Chinese marker-drawing teaching sheet, TWO COLUMNS by THREE ROWS, exactly SIX numbered panels, same style as an approachable handmade lesson chart on clean white paper. Input image is the FINISHED ARTWORK reference: preserve EXACT composition, squirrel pose, acorn and tail geometry, and carmine/olive/gold/yellow/brown palette across all six panels. No alternative subjects. Header exact Chinese text "002 松鼠抱橡果" and underneath "24 金黄 · 37 浅黄 · 92 巧克力棕 · 41 橄榄绿 · 11 洋红". All text crisp readable Chinese sans-serif, ample gutters, each panel title ABOVE its progressive drawing and one short instruction BELOW, no text over drawing. Top-left through bottom-right:
01 "定位大形": show pale GREY pencil outlines only for head, body and oversized acorn, identical placement to reference. Caption "先画圆脑袋、短身体和大橡果。"
02 "添加遮挡": same pale grey pencil drawing with simple tail, two paws around acorn edges, ears, feet, muzzle and acorn cap. Erase hidden belly line; no black ink yet. Caption "橡果挡住身体，爪子搭在橡果前。"
03 "24涂松鼠": same composition, fill squirrel body, head, paws and feet solid marigold-gold only. Remaining drawing is pale grey pencil, background white, NO black face or outline. Caption "24平涂身体，口鼻和橡果先留白。"
04 "37与92": keep gold, add pale yellow 37 to acorn body and muzzle, chocolate brown 92 to broad acorn cap and tail. Background and ground still white, all outlines pencil GREY, no black eyes or face. Caption "37涂浅黄，92涂橡果帽和尾巴。"
05 "11与41": preserve all object colors, add flat carmine red 11 background and olive green 41 ground, finish all five color areas while outlines and facial positions still pencil grey. Caption "11填背景，41涂地面，绕开主体。"
06 "干透后勾线": COMPLETE FINISHED reference image with substantial natural slightly wobbly BLACK pen contours, black dot eyes, nose and small curved mouth, tiny paw detail if needed, no white gel overlay. Caption "完全干透，再勾黑线与五官。"
Footer exact Chinese: "本次基础：前后遮挡。橡果挡身体，爪子在橡果前。"
This is D1 beginner illustration with flat dye-marker strokes, simple closed shapes, no realistic fur, no gradients, no glossy vector finish. Leave a narrow white margin around individual artwork squares in each panel. Crucial sequencing: no early black fineliner in panels1-5; only final panel black ink. Only final panel has face ink. Two tiny eye whites in reference are OPTIONAL: omit them, plain black dot eyes are fine. No watermark or other text. Six steps, no extra panels.
